remarks: Welcome to this quiet and secure 12-unit elevator building in the heart of South Norwalk, complete with a private garage parking space and guest parking. This end-unit condo features hardwood floors, an open-concept kitchen with granite countertops, and an expansive living and dining area with space for a home office. The bedroom offers a generous walk-in closet, while central air conditioning and efficient gas heat provide year-round comfort. Enjoy an unbeatable walkable lifestyle just moments from everything SoNo has to offer, including The SoNo Collection, acclaimed restaurants, the South Norwalk Harbor, dog-friendly Oyster Shell Park, the newly renovated Maritime Aquarium, and the movie theater. This condo offers the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and location. Strong credit and income only. Background check, proof of income, ID, and references required. Small pets considered on case by case basis.
